scope: Unified Iris-on-Metal render correctness, admission, diagnosis, and performance evaluation

suite_model.conformance: Deterministic render-contract manifests, attachment readbacks, expectations, and first-divergence reports.
suite_model.admission: A short real-client probe proves that the selected optimization lane actually executes before expensive paired performance trials begin.
suite_model.performance: Low-overhead structured counters and ABBA-paired baseline/candidate trials with heavy producer capture disabled.
suite_model.diagnostic: Focused producer detail and attachment readback for the first divergent semantic pass only.

identity_requirements: Iris, Sodium and shader-pack versions or hashes
resolution, display refresh and UI scale
macOS, Xcode, Swift and Java versions

correctness_gate.performance_only_reuse_rule: MODE=performance must receive METALLUM_CORRECTNESS_GATE pointing to a prior passing gate.json from the same source/binary/scenario identity.
rules: Every requested capture completes and the pass manifest finalizes.
No dropped trace event, pending capture, Metal validation error, or unexplained attachment/image difference is allowed.
Unsupported semantics reject or disable before execution; silent approximation is forbidden.
A screenshot-only match cannot prove depth, motion, reactive, shadow, or HDR attachment correctness.

admission_gate.source: the unique native-fullscreen-baseline.json payload emitted by the candidate probe

rules.terrain-icb: attempts, accepted batches and draws are positive; attempts and windowed native allocations equal accepted batches; completion lag is within three in-flight submissions; exhausted-budget batches are skipped in Java before FFM; native budget and zero-sized-allocation fallbacks are forbidden
rules.pipeline-prewarm: runtimePipelineCompiles is present and equals zero after warmup
rules.all-safe-lanes: at least one selected Iris lane proves runtime activation

measurement_protocol.block_order: ABBA or equivalent randomized interleaving; never run all baselines before all candidates
measurement_protocol.aggregation: Aggregate frames within each completed trial first, then compare baseline and candidate within each block.
measurement_protocol.failed_or_incomplete_trial_rule: A nonzero or missing exit status is excluded from paired analysis and can never contribute to acceptance.
measurement_protocol.source_report_uniqueness: Exactly one unique report payload is allowed per trial; byte-identical copies are permitted, non-identical copies reject the trial.
measurement_protocol.sample_window_rule: A metric is available only when its sample window matches measuredFrameIntervals; warmup and measured samples may not be mixed.

acceptance_rule: Accept only when correctness and admission pass, mandatory structured FPS exists, at least one target metric improves in at least 75% of four or more paired blocks, and no guardrail exceeds its regression limit.
required_artifacts: comparison.json when paired performance trials started
comparison.md when paired performance trials started
human_approval_boundaries: force push, rebase shared history, merge or release
change supported Minecraft, Iris or Sodium versions
accept a visual/semantic difference as intentional without an existing specification
delete worlds, shader packs, captures or unrelated files
enable an optimization by default when admission or runtime evidence is incomplete
